rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0005, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=11, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-3 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = epochs 10->11 (everything else held EXACTLY at iter-2: lpd_iters=3, hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, lr=5e-4 cosine, train_n=200, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). LIMITER = under-trained, NOT capacity-limited: iter-1 (iters5/ep6) SSIM 0.84271 hr0.000 in 1149.5s=19.16min; iter-2 (iters3/ep10) SSIM 0.863635 hr0.000 in 1079.3s=17.99min. The +0.021 SSIM from +4 epochs (with the depth cut) proves the net is still climbing the training curve, so epochs is the lever; hr still pinned at the LD-FBP floor (0.000) but RMSE flat (0.001721->0.001781). BUDGET MATH vs 20-min wall (1200s): iter-2 ran 1079.3s at 10 epochs => marginal epoch cost <=107.9s/epoch (over-attributing ALL of iter-2 incl. the fixed 214-slice val pass to epochs). epochs 10->11 worst-case = 1079.3 + 107.9 = 1187s = 19.8min < 1200s, fits with margin (true marginal cost is lower since val overhead is non-trivially folded into that bound). Could NOT safely push to 12 (worst-case 1295s=21.6min > 20-min budget). lpd_hidden^ or lpd_iters^ both ADD per-sample projector cost and would blow the wall (iter-1 at iters=5 already hit 19.16min). HYP: one more epoch lifts SSIM monotonically (predict ~0.866-0.870) and, if the climb is steep enough, clears the LD-FBP floor (hr>0). FALSIFIER: SSIM flat/down vs 0.863635 OR hr still 0.000 => epochs is saturating in this 20-min budget and a budget-bound projector-in-loop LPD cannot clear FBP on 2304-view Mayo at this capacity (documented ceiling); next iter would need capacity (hidden^) traded against a deeper budget, not more epochs.
